comment: The LHR may be treated as the primary source for patient-facing digital wallets. A wallet may hold selected copies or credentials rather than provide access to the full longitudinal record.

citation.raw: §Lifelong Health Record, 4 p.159 l.Relationship to other systems

anchor.note: placed on the block, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (high): LHR relationship paragraph on PHR apps / Digital Health Wallets as access layer.

public.text: The LHR may be treated as the primary source for patient-facing digital wallets. A wallet may hold selected copies or credentials rather than provide access to the full longitudinal record.
public.suggestedRevision: Describe wallets, portals, mobile applications, printed summaries, and assisted channels as possible access mechanisms that consume defined LHR services.
